combinations.magnitude: threshold stable Day 7 to Day 14 after miR-203a-down in PCSK1-up rats; significant increase (p<0.001) in PCSK1-NC rats
combinations.evidence_quote: Further administration of miR-203a-down (Day 7) did not elicit any additive effect on mechanical threshold in CCI-ION rats treated with PCSK1-up, as evidenced by the stability of the mechanical threshold from Day 7 through Day 14 after intra-ARC injection of miR-203a-down (Fig. 6n).

combinations.magnitude: miR-203a-down attenuated allodynia in NC-siRNA rats but had no such effect in POMC-siRNA rats
combinations.evidence_quote: Further intra-ARC injection of miR-203a-down (Day 3) markedly attenuated mechanical allodynia in CCI-ION rats pretreated with NC-siRNA, while CCI-ION rats subjected to POMC-siRNA elicited no such effect (Fig. 7m), demonstrating that miR-203a-3p participates in neuropathic pain behaviors by regulating β-EP synthesis in ARC neurons.

combinations.magnitude: alleviation completely abolished, lasting at least 3 h, recovered at 6 h
combinations.evidence_quote: Subsequent intravenous administration of the specific μ-opioid receptor antagonist CTAP (Day 7) completely abolished the miR-203a-down-mediated alleviation of mechanical hyperalgesia in CCI-ION-operated rats.
